report: МР находка: МР данни за малък ставен излив. Костите, формиращи дясната колянна става са с нормална форма и сигнален интензитет. Ставният хрущял на фемура, тибията и пателата е интактен. Предната и задната кръстна връзка са със запазена цялост.  МР данни за лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус – 3 grade. В задния рог на менискуса се вижда хиперинтензна линия с кос ход, съответстваща на скъсване. Скъсването достига до края на менискуса и до ставния хрущял на тибията. Предният рог медиалния менискус е интактен. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус. Нормално изобразяване на латералния и медиалния колатерален лигамент. Патела, ретинакулуми – нормално изобразяване. Лигамент на пателата и сухожилие на мускулус квадрицепс феморис- нормално изобразяване. МР данни за малка мултилокуларна Бекерова киста с типична локализация, между сухожилията на м.семимебранозус и м. семитендинозус. Заключение:  МР данни за лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус – 3-та степен. Малък ставен излив. Бекерова киста.

The medial collateral ligament, posterior oblique ligament, fibular collateral ligament, biceps femoris tendon insertion, and iliotibial band are intact. Low-grade partial-thickness tear of the proximal fibers of the fibular collateral ligament.

The patellar retinacula are intact. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 11 mm, within normal limits. The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

Trace knee joint fluid. Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration.

IMPRESSION:
1. Low-grade partial-thickness tear of the proximal fibers of the lateral collateral ligament.
2. Subtle patellofemoral chondrosis as described.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Four-week history of knee pain localized to the anterior and medial aspect of the knee after twisting and hyperextension injury.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Scattered areas of full-thickness fissuring along the lateral patellar facet with mild subchondral marrow edema, low-grade cartilage loss about the median ridge and medial patellar facet. The trochlear cartilage remains intact.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis. No tendon tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: Edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 12 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Mild edema involving superolateral Hoffa's fat, may reflect underlying impingement.
2.	Mild patellofemoral compartment chondrosis.

Interprétation : 
Il y a un petit épanchement intra-articulaire. Pas de kyste de Baker significatif avec un liséré de liquide au sein du récessus poplité. 
En corrélation avec les radiographies du genou droit, suspicion d’un ossicule méniscal au sein de la corne postérieure du ménisque interne mesurant 7-8mm de diamètre avec déchirure radiaire transfixiante à la jonction de la corne postérieure et de la racine postérieure de même qu’au niveau de la corne postérieure du ménisque interne avec extrusion significative du corps méniscal de façon associée. Ceci est nouveau dans l’intervalle. Stabilité d’une déchirure longitudinale horizontale centrée au corps du ménisque interne s’étendant légèrement aux cornes postérieures et antérieures et à la surface articulaire inférieure. 
Également dans l’intervalle, il y a progression significative des changements dégénératifs au compartiment fémoro-tibial interne avec perte transfixiante des surfaces chondrales, principalement aux surfaces portantes et changements sous-chondraux réactionnels associés. Ostéophytes marginaux modérés. 
Le ligament collatéral interne est intact sans déchirure. 
Légers changements de signal au sein de la corne antérieure du ménisque externe suggérant des changements de nature mucoïde dégénératifs. Pas de franche déchirure notée. 
Changements dégénératifs légers à modérés au compartiment fémoro-tibial externe avec atténuation/fissure chondrale partielle à la surface portante et petits ostéophytes marginaux associés. 
Le complexe ligamentaire collatéral externe est intact sans déchirure. 
Les ligaments croisés antérieur et postérieur sont intacts sans déchirure. Petit kyste intra-osseux réactionnel sous l’insertion distale du ligament croisé postérieur. 
L’alignement patellofémoral est préservé. Changements dégénératifs modérés à sévères au compartiment patellofémoral, plus marqués le long de la facette patellaire externe et apex patellaire avec fissures chondrales transfixiantes et changements sous-chondraux réactionnels associés. Ceci a minimalement progressé dans l’intervalle. Petits ostéophytes marginaux. 
Légère tendinose à l’insertion distale du tendon du quadriceps et de façon plus diffuse au niveau du tendon patellaire. Pas de franche déchirure notée. 
Conclusion : 
Nouvelle déchirure radiale transfixiante à la jonction de la corne postérieure et de la racine postérieure de même qu’au niveau de la corne postérieure du ménisque interne avec extrusion secondaire marquée du corps méniscal tel que détaillé ci-haut. Suspicion d’un ossicule méniscal à la jonction de la corne postérieure et de la racine postérieure du ménisque interne, en corrélation avec une radiographie du genou droit. 
Progression dans l’intervalle des changements dégénératifs/chondropathie tricompartimentaux, sévères au compartiment fémoro-tibial interne et modérés à sévères au compartiment patellofémoral plus marqués le long de la facette patellaire externe de l’apex patellaire. 
Petit épanchement intra-articulaire.

The extensor mechanism is intact and unremarkable. The patellofemoral ligaments are intact and unremarkable.

Articular cartilage of the patellofemoral joint is well-maintained.

T-TG distance is normal.

Lateral meniscus is intact. There is focal anterior and lateral femoral sulcus indentation with minor loss of cartilage of the lateral femoral condyle in the region of the sulcal depression. Overall articular cartilage of the lateral joint compartment is well-maintained.

There is an oblique inferiorly surfacing tear of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus associated with a small posterior parameniscal cyst measuring about 4 to 5 mm in short axis tracking about 3 cm along the posterior margin of the meniscus and extending posterior to the base of the posterior cruciate ligament. Articular cartilage in the medial joint compartment is well-maintained.

The anterior cruciate ligament, posterior cruciate ligament medial collateral ligament and lateral collateral ligament complex including the IT band, fibular collateral ligament, popliteus tendon and biceps femoris tendon all appear intact and unremarkable.

There is significant edema and soft tissue stranding extending from the space between the medial head of gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus muscle proximally into the popliteal fossa behind the distal femur and distally into the medial soft tissues of the calf deep to the pes anserine tendons. The finding is consistent with a ruptured Baker's cyst.

There is no significant knee effusion.

INTERPRETATION: 

Oblique inferiorly surfacing tear of the medial meniscus involving body and posterior horn with associated para meniscal cyst posteriorly.

Nonacute osteochondral impaction injury involving lateral femoral sulcus with some mild focal cartilage loss overlying the region of cortical depression. No associated anterior cruciate ligament injury.

Soft tissue edema compatible with ruptured Baker's cyst.
